notes: The occupation laws in force on 10 Ungerbruni 1926, under Occupation laws in 04 Ownership change.md.
Keyed occupier, then the country whose ground is held. Each occupied country is
governed separately: a power holding two countries picks a set for each, and
taking ground off a third country starts that one from nothing.
`laws` holds up to three. Each is the name of a policy or decree the occupier
already has in force, or one of Martial law, Secret police, Forced labour and
Military governor, which may be taken here whatever it does at home. They apply
in the occupied provinces alone and carry no compass.
`stateOwned` is optional and overrides what the occupier does with the industries
it has taken. Without it the ground keeps the ownership its own country gave it.
